# ai-models

Whisper small.en files for local transcription.

## whisper.cpp

Model: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin
SHA-256: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.bin.sha256
Manifest: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/ggml-small.en.manifest.json

Use:
`whisper-cli -m ggml-small.en.bin -f audio.wav`

If direct binary download fails, use the latest successful `Update Whisper small.en offline model` Actions run and artifact matching `openai-whisper-small-en-ggml-*`.

## OpenAI Whisper / PyTorch

ZIP: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip
SHA-256: https://github.com/jwedwards-usa/ai-models/releases/latest/download/openai-whisper-small-en-offline-model.zip.sha256

## ChatGPT

Prompt: https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/chatgpt-prompt.txt

## Metadata

https://jwedwards-usa.github.io/ai-models/model.json
